articles.headline: World Cup Daily: Scotland defeat Haiti, Brazil fans take over NYC
articles.description: Enjoy all the action from Saturday's World Cup matches, with features, news, video analysis and color from around the competition.

articles.headline: Scotland beat Haiti for 1st World Cup win in 36 years
articles.description: John McGinn deflected a shot off an opposing defender and past goalkeeper Johny Placide in the 28th minute, and Scotland defeated Haiti 1-0 in Group C of the World Cup on Saturday.

articles.headline: Socceroos vs. Türkiye LIVE: Australia's opening 2026 World Cup match
Socceroos veterans dropped for Australia's World Cup opener
articles.description: Australia coach Tony Popovic has two massive gambles ahead of his side's opening fixture against Türkiye, dropping captain and 100-cap veteran Mathew Ryan and vice-captain Jackson Irvine.

articles.headline: Morocco 'not alarmed' by Yassine Bounou injury concern, but further tests required
articles.description: Morocco goalkeeper Yassine Bounou will undergo tests on Sunday after picking up a shoulder injury in a collision with Brazil's Raphinha in their 1-1 FIFA World Cup draw on Saturday.
